New library: shared deploy-time conventions for our Modal apps (remote_service_connector, modal_litellm), extracted from the code both previously duplicated. Holds the deploy env/id readers (MNGR_DEPLOY_ENV / MINDS_DEPLOY_ID with the unset-sentinel safety property), warm-pool and scaledown-window readers, stamped Modal Secret naming (<service>-<tier>-<deploy_id>), the source-mount ignore rule (only production .py files ship; tests and the entrypoint are excluded), and Neon direct_database_url.

The README is the canonical documentation for how our Modal services are structured and deployed, and why: file-path deploys, the single trailing add_local_python_source operation, the import boundary, deploy-time env serialization, and the stamped-secret rollback model. The lib itself is stdlib+modal only (enforced by its own boundary test) because it ships into every consumer's container as source.
